title: How to Make Headphones Feel Better for Long Listening Sessions
summary: Learn simple fixes for headphone pressure, from fit and pads to better gear picks for comfortable long listening sessions.
body_text: If your headphones start feeling like a clamp after an hour, you are definitely not alone. Sore ears, a tender crown, and that constant need to readjust are all signs your headset is working against your comfort instead of supporting it. The good news is that headphone pressure is usually fixable. In many cases, it comes down to fit, pad material, weight, or simply using the wrong style for the way you listen. Below, we will break down what causes that pressure, the easiest ways to ease it, and a few desk-friendly gear picks that can help you build a more comfortable setup overall. 1. What You Need Before You Start Before you start tweaking your headphones, figure out where the discomfort is coming from. Some models press too hard along the sides of the head. Others dig into the top of the head because the band is stiff or the headset is too heavy. And sometimes the problem is simply heat buildup from pads that trap too much warmth. A good comfort check starts with three things: fit, material, and how long you wear them at a time. Ideally, your headphones should stay put without squeezing, seal well without pinching, and stay reasonably cool during a long gaming session, workday, or playlist marathon. Common signs that headphone pressure is too high Red marks or soreness around the ears after use Pressure on the crown of the head from the headband Heat buildup and sweating inside the ear cups A need to keep shifting the headphones to feel relief Jaw or temple fatigue during long sessions 2. Understand the Main Causes of Ear Pressure For many over-ear and on-ear headphones, clamp force is the biggest reason they feel uncomfortable. If the headband pushes inward too strongly, the ear cups compress the sides of your head and ears. That tighter fit can help with isolation, but it also makes fatigue show up much faster. Pad design matters just as much. Shallow pads can bring the drivers too close to your ears, while firm memory foam may create hot spots even when it feels supportive at first. If you want a less sealed feel, semi-open models are worth a look. For example, the Monoprice Semi-Open Over Ear Wired Headphones, Model 143242 are designed to balance ambient noise reduction with more natural sound, and they use soft velvet honeycomb ear caps and a leather headband for extended listening comfort. Weight and wear time also play a big role. Even a well-padded headset can start to feel tiring if it is heavy or if you wear it for hours without a break. In most cases, the most comfortable setup combines a lighter design, breathable pads, and the habit of taking short pauses before pressure builds up. 3. Step-by-Step Ways to Reduce Headphone Pressure There is no one-size-fits-all fix, so it helps to improve comfort in stages. Start with fit adjustments, then move on to pads and listening habits. Small changes can go a long way, especially if the discomfort is annoying but not severe. Try each adjustment one at a time when possible. That makes it much easier to tell which change actually helped instead of guessing. If the headset still feels wrong after the basics, the model may simply not be a great match for your head shape. Step 1: Adjust the headband carefully Extend both sides evenly so the cups sit level and the band rests on the widest part of your head. If the headphones feel too tight, some users gently stretch them over a box or stack of books for a short period. Just be careful here, since stretching too far can weaken the fit and reduce seal quality. Step 2: Reposition the ear cups The center of the ear cup should line up with your ear opening. If the cups sit too high or too low, pressure points become more noticeable. A slight rotation can also help spread pressure more evenly across the pad instead of concentrating it in one spot. Step 3: Replace or upgrade the ear pads Soft, breathable pads often feel better than worn-out or overly firm ones. Velvet and velour usually run cooler over time, while thicker memory foam can reduce direct contact if the original pads are shallow. If your pads are flattened, replacing them is often the fastest comfort upgrade available. Step 4: Use scheduled breaks For long gaming or work sessions, take the headphones off for a few minutes every hour. Even a short break gives your skin and cartilage time to recover. This is especially helpful with tighter models that seem fine at first but become painful later. Step 5: Lower unnecessary listening pressure People often turn the volume up when their headset feels less secure or when the room is noisy. That creates a second problem, because louder listening can make fatigue feel worse. A stable fit and a quieter desk setup let you keep the volume lower while still hearing details clearly. 4. Choose the Right Headphones for Long Sessions If headphone pressure keeps coming back, the simplest fix may be choosing a more comfort-focused design. In general, over-ear headphones with breathable pads are easier to live with for long sessions than very tight on-ear models. Semi-open and open designs can also feel less sealed, which many users experience as less pressure overall. The Jabra Evolve2 75 PC Wireless Headset is a strong comfort-first option for desk use. It features extra-soft cushions, adjustable advanced active noise cancelling, an 8-microphone setup, up to 36 hours of battery life, and a wireless range up to 30 meters. With a 40mm driver and supra-aural ear coupling, it is built for communication-heavy work while still aiming for all-day comfort. That makes it especially useful if your day includes calls, meetings, and music from the same desk. If you want something that can handle productivity and movement around the room, a wireless headset with ANC and soft padding is often easier to wear than a heavier, more rigid gaming headset. For cooler long-session wear, look for breathable pads and lower clamp force For office calls, prioritize ANC and microphone quality For mixed use, choose a lightweight wireless design with a stable but not aggressive fit For natural sound and less sealed pressure, consider semi-open or open-back styles 5. Desktop PC Recommendations That Pair Well With Comfortable Headphones Comfort is not just about the headset itself. Your desktop setup matters too. A quieter, better-cooled PC can cut down on fan noise, improve call clarity, and make it easier to listen at lower volumes. That can mean less ear fatigue and a calmer desk overall. If you are building a more comfort-friendly setup, these desktop PCs stand out for different reasons. For premium all-around performance, the Cooler Master TD5 Pro – Intel Core Ultra 9-285K – GeForce RTX 5090 – 32GB DDR5 6000MHz – 2TB M.2 NVMe SSD – Windows 11 – 360mm AIO – Gaming PC includes an Intel Core Ultra 9 285K, 32GB DDR5 6000 memory, a 2TB M.2 NVMe SSD, and a 360mm AIO cooler. That kind of cooling-focused build is a smart match if you want strong performance without the headset having to compete against loud thermal noise. If you want another high-end option, the GIGABYTE AORUS SUPREME 5 AS5A7N9-5000 pairs an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D with a GeForce RTX 5090, 64GB DDR5 memory, a 2TB Gen5 SSD, WiFi 7, and a 360mm WATERFORCE AIO cooler. Its 2.5G Ethernet, Bluetooth 5.3, and DisplayPort 2.1b outputs make it a strong high-performance workstation for users who want a clean, cable-friendly desk and a very responsive system. For a slightly more compact but still powerful option, the ABS Kaze Ruby Gaming PC includes an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RTX 5090, 32GB DDR5 6000MHz, a 2TB PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe SSD, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, and a 360mm liquid cooler. That makes it a strong pick if you want high-end performance without overcomplicating the desktop environment. For a more mainstream budget-minded system, the ABS Cyclone Aqua Prebuilt Gaming PC offers an Intel Core i5-14400F, GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7, 32GB DDR4-3200, and a 1TB PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe SSD. If you just want a reliable machine for work, streaming, and casual gaming while using comfortable headphones, this configuration covers the basics without pushing you into unnecessary spend. 6. Build a More Comfortable Listening Setup Once the headphone fit is under control, the rest of your desk should support relaxed listening. Keep your desk at the right height so the cable or headband does not pull the headphones downward. If you use a headset with a boom microphone, make sure it is not pushing the cups out of alignment. A stable posture can also reduce the urge to constantly readjust the headset. It helps to cut down on background distractions too. A quieter PC case, cleaner cable routing, and a stable chair position all make it easier to listen at lower levels. Lower volume reduces long-session fatigue, and a calmer setup keeps your attention on the content instead of the pressure on your ears. Use a headset stand so the pads keep their shape between sessions Keep ear pads clean to preserve softness and airflow Avoid wearing glasses frames that create extra pressure under the cups Take breaks before soreness appears, not after it starts Match the headphone type to the task: calls, music, gaming, or travel 7. Final Takeaway Headphone pressure is usually manageable once you know what is causing it. For many people, the best fix is a combination of better fit, softer pads, shorter sessions, and a headset design that better matches the way they listen. If you need all-day comfort, focus on lightweight construction, breathable materials, and clamp force that stays secure without squeezing. For desk users, pairing comfortable headphones with a quieter, better-cooled desktop can make a real difference in how long you can wear them comfortably. Whether you choose a semi-open wired model for a lighter feel or a wireless ANC headset for meetings and movement, the goal stays the same: stable sound, less pressure, and a setup you can wear for hours without thinking about it. Frequently Asked Questions How do I know if my headphones are too tight? If you get red marks, soreness around your ears, or pressure on the crown of your head after a short session, the clamp force is probably too high. A comfortable fit should feel secure without making you want to keep adjusting the headset. Will replacing ear pads really improve comfort? Yes, especially if the original pads are flattened, firm, or trapping heat. Softer, more breathable pads can reduce direct pressure and make long listening sessions feel much easier. Are over-ear headphones usually more comfortable than on-ear models? Usually, yes, because over-ear designs spread pressure around the ear instead of pressing directly on it. Even so, fit still matters, since a heavy or tight over-ear headset can still become uncomfortable over time. What should I look for in a headset for all-day work calls? Look for a lightweight wireless headset with soft cushions, a stable but not aggressive fit, and clear microphone performance. If your workspace is noisy, active noise cancelling can also help you keep the volume lower, which often reduces fatigue. Does a quieter desktop PC help with headphone comfort? Yes, because lower fan noise lets you listen at a lower volume, which can reduce long-session fatigue. A cooler and quieter PC also makes the whole desk environment feel calmer and less distracting. title: Tariffs, Trade and Supply Chain Solutions: How Lineage Can Help Businesses Navigate a Shifting Landscape
summary: Lineage's bonded warehouses, USDA-approved I-Houses and integrated solutions help businesses navigate tariffs and streamline supply chains.
body_text: Blog // Services Tariffs, Trade and Supply Chain Solutions: How Lineage Can Help Businesses Navigate a Shifting Landscape November 19, 2025 Share This Article Facebook LinkedIn Twitter In the dynamic world of global trade and politics, the word “tariff” is a constant source of confusion and debate. Tariffs are a policy tool used by nations around the world, with the power to affect supply chain strategies, reshape industries and alter the geopolitical landscape. In recent months, tariffs have become a hot topic in political discourse, with a heavy focus stemming from the US election. With new tariffs likely on the horizon, and the potential for retaliatory tariffs, we’ll take a look at what tariffs are, how they can affect supply chains and how Lineage helps customers stay agile and compliant through its expanding import and export capabilities. What Are Tariffs, and Why Do They Matter? In simple terms, tariffs are taxes or duties placed on imported goods. To help understand their impact, one possible example is if, hypothetically, the US places a 25% tariff on imported avocados from Mexico , then any company importing avocados from Mexico must pay 25% of the value or amount of goods to the government before being allowed to sell the avocados in the US. These additional costs are typically passed down to the consumers by raising prices. For global companies that rely on various goods produced and sold in several different countries, tariffs can send ripples through their supply chain. The Domino Effect: Tariffs’ Impact on Supply Chains Tariffs can have wide scale effects in the global trade landscape, setting up a domino effect that cascades down the supply chain, from the producers to the consumers. Some of these effects in the US could include: Navigating complex quotas and compliance with government agencies like Customs Border Protection (CBP), the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) add layers of bureaucracy. Potential go-to-market delays due to goods often needing to be stored in bonded warehouses while waiting on inspections. Higher tariffs could spark shortages in grocery stores as fewer food products are imported into the US. Businesses are forced to make the decision of either absorbing the added expense from tariffs or passing it along to consumers with higher priced goods. These challenges can prove to be insurmountable without the expertise of a supply chain partner like Lineage. Lineage’s Supply Chain Solutions Turn Import Challenges into Opportunities At Lineage, we aren't just responding to these challenges—we’re anticipating them. By leveraging our cold storage network , expertise and suite of supply chain solutions, we help businesses navigate the complexities of import regulations and tariffs to keep their supply chains moving efficiently and seamlessly. 1. Bonded Warehousing: A Strategic Advantage Bonded warehouses are the unsung heroes of import management. They are facilities where imported goods are brought in and stored under the supervision of CBP. Here, they wait until certain conditions are met, including compliance with import quotas, inspections and payment of duties or tariffs. Once the conditions are met, the products can be released to the market. The best way to think of it is that these facilities essentially act as "parking lots" for goods coming into the country. Lineage now operates 13 bonded warehouses across the U.S. and more than 60 globally , having increased its bonded warehouse capacity to meet growing importer demand. Benefits of Utilizing Lineage’s Bonded Warehouses Include: Flexibility: By flexing bonded space up or down in our bonded warehouses, Lineage helps customers minimize costs while maintaining compliance. Network Scale: With 16 bonded warehouses across the U.S. and more than 60 globally , Lineage’s network gives customers secure, compliant access to key ports and trade hubs worldwide. Lineage’s bonded sites are backed by the Import and Export Excellence Team—a group of 20+ specialists focused on customs compliance, documentation and process optimization to help customers avoid costly delays. 2. USDA-Approved I-Houses: Seamless Customs Compliance Another hurdle that businesses must overcome when importing certain products into the US is inspection compliance. Lineage streamlines the inspection process with our USDA-approved I-House facilities. I-Houses, or inspection houses, are facilities that specialize in in-house USDA inspections. Streamlined inspection services are crucial for products like meat and poultry, which require 100% USDA inspection before hitting the market. This process helps prevent the spread of diseases like foot-and-mouth disease, while getting these products to market quickly and efficiently. Lineage operates 42 USDA-approved I-Houses, strategically located near major ports and points of entry across the US. Benefits of Utilizing Lineage’s I-House Facilities Include: Lineage I-Houses streamline the inspection process by providing in-house inspection services in cooperation with the USDA to help ensure goods meet all regulatory requirements before entering the U.S. market. Lineage’s network of 42 I-Houses across the US, near key ports and points of entry help minimize transit times while maximizing efficiency. 3. Integrated Solutions: The One-Stop Supply Chain Solution Another key benefit of partnering with Lineage is the ability to bundle up on services to become more agile in the face of the ever-evolving global trade landscape. This helps Lineage customers quickly adapt to changes in the market, while maintaining real-time visibility into their supply chain. We work hard to be the one-stop-shop for supply chain services. Existing customers that bundle from Lineage’s suite of integrated solutions benefit from our competitively priced One Lineage fee structure. With a network of cold storage warehouses , temperature-controlled transportation offerings, including our Velocities multi-vendor cross-border program , and customs compliance expertise , Lineage helps ensure our customers products are properly handled from start to finish. Pair that with our cutting-edge warehouse management platform, Lineage Link® , acting as the eye-in-the-sky, and Lineage customers have end-to-end, real-time visibility into their supply chain. This includes visibility into orders, inventory and shipment statuses across the Lineage network of facilities. From cold storage to customs compliance, our integrated solutions cover nearly every link in the supply chain and help set businesses up for success when importing food products into the US. Lineage Helps Prepare for a Dynamic Trade Environment Trade policies are always evolving as the geopolitical landscape shifts and changes. That’s why it’s important to partner with a supply chain company that doesn’t just react to trade challenges, but anticipates them. Tariffs will continue being a diplomatic tool for world leaders in the years to come. To be successful, businesses must be prepared to adapt. Agility in supply chain management helps set businesses up for success. Lineage’s expanded bonded warehouse network, 42 USDA-approved I-Houses and integrated import and export solutions position the company as a trusted partner for navigating shifting trade conditions. With increased bonded capacity, a strengthened blast freezing network and a dedicated team of import and export specialists, Lineage helps businesses stay ready as the global trade landscape evolves. Invest in Supply Chain Solutions for Imports Whether you’re planning for tariff impacts, exploring bonded storage options or streamlining your supply chain, Lineage has the solutions you need. With our expansive network, integrated solutions and commitment to excellence, we’re here to help you navigate the future of trade. Contact us today about supporting your import business. title: From Thousands of Variants to One Answer
summary: Learn how GeneDx uses MIMI Ranker, an AI-powered genomic interpretation tool, to prioritize genetic variants faster and support more efficient rare disease diagnosis.
body_text: Key takeaways MIMI Ranker helps GeneDx clinical teams prioritize variants more consistently and efficiently. In validation across more than 16,000 clinical exome and genome cases, 98% of diagnostic variants ranked in the top 3 candidates. AI-powered prioritization helps reduce manual burden and focus analyst review on the most clinically relevant variants. GeneDx combines AI technology with expert clinical interpretation to support faster and more reliable rare disease diagnoses. How AI is changing what’s possible in genetic diagnosis A patient presents with developmental delay, seizures, and no clear diagnosis. You order genome sequencing . The result? ~5,000,000 variants. Some are common. Most are benign. One or two might explain everything. The challenge isn’t sequencing. It’s knowing where to look. What if the right answer was already in the top 3? That's the goal behind MIMI Ranker, our AI-powered variant prioritization tool, built to help our clinical team surface the variants most likely to explain a patient's condition, faster and with greater confidence. In a validation study across more than 16,000 clinical exome and genome cases:1 98% of diagnostic variants were ranked in the top 3 candidates 99.6% were ranked in the top 10 ‍ That means instead of searching through hundreds of variants, our team can focus immediately on what matters most, moving patients closer to a diagnosis without unnecessary delay. A closer look: how this changes a real case* * Illustrative example A pediatric patient presents with: Global developmental delay Hypotonia Seizures ‍ Genome sequencing identifies ~5,000,000 variants. Traditional workflow: Filter by frequency, inheritance, predicted impact Manually cross-reference phenotype against dozens to hundreds of candidate variants ‍ It's time-intensive, and there's inherent variability across reviewers. With MIMI Ranker: Phenotype data (HPO terms) + variant data are analyzed together Variants are ranked by likelihood of being disease-causing A de novo missense variant in SCN2A surfaces in the top results ‍ Through expert clinical validation, our team confirms a molecular diagnosis of SCN2A-related Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy, a rare neurodevelopmental condition caused by de novo variants in the sodium channel gene SCN2A , which carries real implications for treatment selection. Because for SCN2A , knowing if the variant results in loss-of-function or gain-of-function has direct impact on which therapies are most appropriate, making the speed and precision of that initial prioritization clinically meaningful, not just operationally efficient. With MIMI Ranker, our team looks at the most likely diagnostic variants, not the entire exome. Diagnosis happens faster. Confidence is higher. And for the patient, that can mean earlier clarity, earlier care decisions, and fewer unanswered questions. What makes MIMI Ranker different? MIMI Ranker was trained and validated on expert reviewed clinical cases, not simulated data. It learns from actual diagnostic outcomes, integrating both variant-level features and structured phenotypic data to prioritize what's most likely to matter for your specific patient. It's also built on a foundation no other lab can replicate: GeneDx Infinity – one of the world’s largest genomic datasets – of more than 2.5 million genetic tests, including over 1 million exomes and genomes, more than 1.4 billion clinical datapoints, and more than 8 million mapped phenotypic datapoints. AI that augments clinical expertise Every MIMI Ranker result is reviewed by our expert clinical analysts. AI handles the scale. Our experts make the call. This is where AI is most powerful: reducing noise, surfacing signal, and allowing our clinical analysts to focus where it matters most, understanding which variants correlate with your patient's specific presentation. Getting patients to answers, sooner For many patients, the hardest part isn’t the test itself. It’s the waiting. The uncertainty. The not knowing. By helping prioritize what matters most, faster, MIMI Ranker supports a simple but meaningful goal: shorten the path from sequencing to diagnosis, so patients can move forward with clarity. GeneDx is the foundational model for rare disease GeneDx is the foundational AI platform for rare disease diagnosis . MIMI Ranker is just one piece of a broader ecosystem of AI tools power our diagnostics and workflow. By accessing Infinity, our interpretation is stronger, more complete, and continuously improving — setting a bar others cannot match.

body_text: How a Free AI Therapist Can Help Reduce Daily Anxiety Daily anxiety has become an increasingly common challenge in today's fast‑paced world. Whether it's worrying about work deadlines, financial pressures, relationships, or constant exposure to social media, millions of people experience persistent stress that affects their emotional well‑being. While traditional therapy remains the gold standard for treating anxiety disorders, many people face barriers such as cost, long waiting lists, limited availability, or uncertainty about where to begin. This is where a free AI therapist can make a meaningful difference. Powered by artificial intelligence and evidence‑based psychological techniques, these digital tools provide accessible emotional support whenever users need it. Although they are not a replacement for licensed mental health professionals, AI therapists can help individuals develop healthier coping strategies, practice mindfulness, and better understand their emotions. In this article, you'll learn how a free AI therapist can help reduce daily anxiety, the science behind AI‑assisted mental health support, its benefits and limitations, and how to use these tools safely as part of your overall wellness routine. What Is a Free AI Therapist? A free AI therapist is an artificial intelligence‑powered chatbot or digital assistant designed to support mental well‑being through conversation. Unlike general AI chatbots, mental health‑focused AI therapists are often trained using principles from established therapeutic approaches, including: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) Mindfulness‑Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) Positive psychology Emotional journaling techniques These tools can guide users through structured conversations, encourage self‑reflection, teach coping skills, and provide emotional support 24 hours a day. Most free AI therapist platforms offer features such as: Guided breathing exercises Mood tracking Anxiety check‑ins Journaling prompts Cognitive reframing exercises Gratitude practices Personalized coping suggestions Because they are available on smartphones and computers, users can access support almost instantly whenever anxiety begins to build. Understanding Daily Anxiety Anxiety is a normal human response to stress. It helps us prepare for challenges and respond to potential threats. However, when anxious thoughts become frequent or overwhelming, they can interfere with daily life. Common symptoms include: Excessive worrying Difficulty concentrating Racing thoughts Restlessness Muscle tension Trouble sleeping Increased heart rate Feeling overwhelmed by small tasks According to the World Health Organization (WHO) , anxiety disorders affect hundreds of millions of people worldwide and are among the most common mental health conditions. Even individuals without a diagnosed anxiety disorder often experience daily anxiety related to work, family responsibilities, health concerns, or financial uncertainty. Early emotional support and healthy coping strategies can help prevent chronic stress from becoming more severe. Why More People Are Turning to AI for Mental Health Support The demand for mental health services continues to grow faster than the available workforce. In many regions, people wait weeks or even months for therapy appointments. Several factors have contributed to the growing popularity of AI mental health tools: Immediate Availability Unlike traditional appointments, AI therapists are available 24/7. Users can seek support during late‑night anxiety episodes, stressful workdays, or moments of emotional distress without waiting for office hours. Reduced Cost Professional therapy can be expensive depending on location and insurance coverage. A free AI therapist lowers the financial barrier, allowing more people to access basic mental wellness support. Privacy Many individuals hesitate to discuss emotional struggles because they fear judgment or stigma. AI conversations can feel less intimidating, encouraging honest self‑expression. Convenience Whether someone is commuting, traveling, or relaxing at home, AI therapy tools fit easily into daily routines. How a Free AI Therapist Helps Reduce Daily Anxiety 1. Provides Immediate Emotional Support One of the greatest strengths of a free AI therapist is immediate accessibility. Daily anxiety often strikes unexpectedly: Before an important meeting During a stressful commute Late at night After receiving upsetting news While overthinking future events Instead of facing these emotions alone, users can begin a conversation immediately. Although AI cannot replace human empathy, simply expressing emotions through conversation can help reduce emotional intensity. Psychologists often describe this process as "affect labeling," where putting feelings into words helps regulate emotional responses. An AI therapist encourages users to slow down, identify their emotions, and process stressful thoughts rather than suppressing them. 2. Helps Identify Anxiety Triggers Many people experience anxiety without fully understanding what causes it. AI therapists often ask reflective questions like: What happened before you started feeling anxious? What thoughts are running through your mind? How intense is your anxiety right now? Have you experienced this situation before? These conversations encourage greater self‑awareness. Over time, users may recognize recurring patterns such as: Workplace stress Social situations Financial concerns Health worries Relationship conflicts Perfectionism Recognizing triggers is one of the first steps toward managing anxiety more effectively. 3. Teaches Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) Techniques Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is one of the most researched and effective treatments for anxiety disorders. Many AI therapists incorporate CBT exercises that help users challenge unhelpful thinking patterns. For example: Automatic Thought: "I'm definitely going to fail this presentation." The AI therapist may respond with questions such as: What evidence supports this belief? What evidence contradicts it? Is there another possible outcome? What would you tell a friend experiencing this thought? This process encourages cognitive restructuring, helping users replace catastrophic thinking with more balanced perspectives. Repeated practice strengthens healthier thinking habits over time. 4. Encourages Mindfulness Anxiety often focuses attention on future uncertainty. Mindfulness teaches people to focus on the present moment rather than imagined worst‑case scenarios. Many free AI therapist platforms guide users through: Deep breathing Body scans Five‑senses grounding exercises Progressive muscle relaxation Short guided meditations Research has shown that mindfulness‑based interventions can reduce anxiety symptoms, improve emotional regulation, and lower perceived stress. Even a five‑minute mindfulness session during a stressful day can help interrupt the cycle of anxious thinking. 5. Supports Emotional Journaling Writing about emotions has long been recognized as a valuable coping strategy. AI therapists make journaling more interactive by asking thoughtful follow‑up questions. Instead of simply recording emotions, users explore: What happened today? How did that situation make you feel? What thoughts kept repeating? What helped you cope? What would you like to improve tomorrow? This reflective process helps organize thoughts that might otherwise feel overwhelming. Over weeks or months, users can observe improvements in emotional patterns and identify situations that consistently trigger anxiety. 6. Promotes Healthy Coping Skills Many people cope with anxiety in unhealthy ways, including: Avoidance Doomscrolling Emotional eating Excessive caffeine Alcohol use Isolation A free AI therapist can recommend healthier alternatives, such as: Taking a short walk Practicing controlled breathing Stretching Drinking water Listening to calming music Calling a trusted friend Breaking overwhelming tasks into smaller steps These practical suggestions help users replace harmful habits with healthier responses. 7. Tracks Mood Over Time One advantage of AI‑powered mental health tools is their ability to recognize patterns across multiple conversations. Mood tracking features allow users to monitor: Anxiety levels Sleep quality Stress triggers Emotional changes Daily habits Over time, users often discover meaningful trends. For example: Anxiety increases after poor sleep. Work meetings consistently trigger stress. Exercise improves mood. Weekend routines reduce anxious thoughts. This insight helps individuals make informed lifestyle changes that support long‑term emotional well‑being. Limitations of a Free AI Therapist Although AI therapy offers many benefits, it also has important limitations. Understanding these limitations helps users maintain realistic expectations and use AI responsibly. It Cannot Diagnose Mental Health Disorders AI therapists are not licensed clinicians and cannot diagnose anxiety disorders, depression, PTSD, or other mental health conditions. Only qualified healthcare professionals can perform comprehensive mental health evaluations. It Cannot Replace Human Therapy AI lacks the clinical judgment, empathy, and nuanced understanding that experienced therapists provide. Complex issues such as: Trauma Abuse Severe depression Substance use disorders Personality disorders Crisis intervention require professional treatment. The American Psychological Association (APA) recommends viewing AI as a supportive tool rather than a replacement for licensed mental health professionals. Responses May Not Always Be Perfect Even advanced AI systems occasionally misunderstand context or generate responses that are too general for an individual's unique situation. Users should think critically about AI‑generated suggestions and consult qualified professionals when making important health decisions. Privacy Matters Before using any AI mental health platform, review its: Privacy policy Data storage practices Encryption standards Data‑sharing policies Choose services that clearly explain how user information is protected. Know When to Seek Professional Help A free AI therapist can be a valuable resource for managing everyday stress and mild anxiety, but it isn't the right solution for every situation. If your symptoms become persistent, intense, or begin interfering with your daily life, it's important to find a therapy online with a licensed mental health professional or schedule an in‑person appointment for personalized care. Seek help from a licensed mental health professional if you experience: Persistent anxiety lasting several weeks Panic attacks Severe depression Difficulty functioning at work or school Thoughts of self‑harm or suicide Feelings of hopelessness If you or someone you know is experiencing a mental health crisis or is at immediate risk of self‑harm, contact your local emergency services or a crisis hotline right away. Who Can Benefit Most from a Free AI Therapist? While AI therapy is not suitable for every situation, it can be especially helpful for people who experience mild to moderate daily stress and want accessible emotional support. Individuals who may benefit include: Students managing academic pressure Professionals experiencing workplace stress Parents balancing family responsibilities Remote workers dealing with isolation Caregivers experiencing emotional fatigue People interested in mindfulness and self‑improvement Individuals waiting for a therapy appointment Anyone looking to build healthier coping habits For many users, AI therapy serves as an accessible companion that encourages reflection, emotional regulation, and positive behavioral change. Conclusion Daily anxiety is a common part of modern life, but it doesn't have to become overwhelming. A free AI therapist offers an accessible way to build healthier coping habits, practice mindfulness, track emotional patterns, and apply evidence‑based techniques such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. Its greatest strengths are convenience, affordability, and immediate availability, making it easier for people to seek support whenever stress arises. At the same time, AI therapy has clear limitations. It cannot diagnose mental health conditions, replace licensed therapists, or provide crisis intervention. Instead, it works best as a complementary tool that encourages self‑awareness and supports everyday emotional wellness. When used consistently alongside healthy lifestyle habits—and with professional care when needed—a free AI therapist can become a valuable part of a proactive approach to managing daily anxiety. By helping users better understand their emotions, challenge anxious thoughts, and develop practical coping strategies, these tools are expanding access to mental health support for people around the world. body_text: Columbus, Ohio [Jan. 10, 2018] – Vertiv, formerly Emerson Network Power, today announced the further expansion of its line of lithium-ion-compatible uninterruptible power systems (UPS). Now qualified for operation with lithium-ion batteries, the Liebert® EXM 480V (50-250 kW/kVA) UPS system expands the energy storage options for mid-sized data centers and next-generation edge applications. The lithium-ion configurations are available in North America. The Liebert EXM 480V is the latest UPS system from Vertiv to be tested and qualified for lithium-ion batteries. This configuration delivers the scalability, flexibility and intelligence of the traditional Liebert EXM UPS system with all the benefits of lithium-ion technology, including longer battery life, reduced size and weight and increased power density. The lithium-ion batteries and battery cabinets are UL listed for use in data center environments. “Today’s customers want options for their diverse networks and specifically for increasingly critical mid-sized and edge facilities,” said Kyle Keeper, vice president, AC power product management, for Vertiv in the Americas. “It is critical that we provide choices to fit the potential environment and architecture. Adding lithium-ion capabilities to the Liebert EXM UPS system is an important new option for our customers seeking core to edge solutions.” The lithium-ion battery management system is compatible with Albér Battery Xplorer battery monitoring software from Vertiv, to aggregate and monitor system level performance. The system is supported by Vertiv services and is LIFE™ Services compatible. In addition to lithium-ion batteries, the Liebert EXM UPS system also can be configured for flywheel operation to support applications that need short ride-through times and do not want batteries. For more information on the Liebert EXM and other UPS solutions from Vertiv, visit www.VertivCo.com . About Vertiv Vertiv designs, builds and services critical infrastructure that enables vital applications for data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities. Formerly Emerson Network Power, Vertiv supports today’s growing mobile and cloud computing markets with a portfolio of power, thermal and infrastructure management solutions including the Chloride®, Liebert®, NetSure™ and Trellis ™ brands. Sales in fiscal 2016 were $4.4 billion. For more information, visit VertivCo.com . CONTACT: Vince McMorrow T +614 383 1622 E Vince.McMorrow@Fahlgren.com

title: ServisFirst Bank Hosts SBA Roundtable to Advance Small Business Access to Capital
summary: Read the latest from ServisFirst Bank.
body_text: Financial Leaders from across Alabama Convene at ServisFirst Headquarters BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – ServisFirst Bank , a subsidiary of ServisFirst Bancshares (NYSE:SFBS), is pleased to announce that it hosted a roundtable discussion in partnership with the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) , bringing together representatives from 12 financial institutions to discuss strategies for expanding access to capital for small businesses across the country. Held June 16, 2026, at ServisFirst Bank's headquarters in Birmingham, the roundtable provided an opportunity for banking leaders and SBA officials to exchange ideas on strengthening SBA lending programs and identifying opportunities to improve the effectiveness and reach of these initiatives. Discussions centered on enhancing access to capital, streamlining lending processes and supporting the continued growth of America's more than 36 million small businesses. ServisFirst Bank welcomed Bill Briggs , Deputy Administrator of the U.S. Small Business Administration, and John Rich , Deputy Regional Administrator of the U.S. Small Business Administration, who shared insights into the SBA's current priorities and future direction. Their remarks underscored the importance of strong partnerships between the SBA and financial institutions in helping entrepreneurs access the resources they need to start, grow and sustain their businesses. “Community banks and lending partners are essential to fueling local economies, connecting small businesses with the capital they need to succeed,” states Bill Briggs, Deputy Administrator of the U.S. Small Business Administration. “Working together, we can continue to strengthen SBA capital access programs, lower barriers for borrowers, and create jobs. Ensuring entrepreneurs across Alabama, and across the country, have the resources needed to grow and support their communities.” The event also featured participation from Brad Bolton , President, CEO & Senior Leader of Community Spirit Bank and Past Chairman of the Independent Community Bankers of America, who emphasized the value of collaboration among financial institutions and the SBA. “Having Deputy Administrator Briggs visit our great state shows the importance that community banks and SBA lending partners play in helping our local economies,” states Brad Bolton, President, CEO & Senior Leader of Community Spirit Bank. “His commitment to meeting directly with lenders and borrowers creates meaningful opportunities to improve SBA programs and better serve small businesses. I appreciate the hospitality that Rodney and the entire staff of ServisFirst Bank showed us as we gathered at their corporate headquarters to discuss important issues and learn how the SBA is modernizing to better serve lenders and borrowers. It was a great day for our state!” ServisFirst Bank regularly partners with organizations that promote economic development and support entrepreneurs, reinforcing the Bank's commitment to helping businesses of all sizes thrive in the communities it serves. “On behalf of everyone at ServisFirst Bank, I want to thank Bill Briggs, John Rich, Brad Bolton, and the U.S. Small Business Administration for partnering with us and making this important discussion possible,” states Rodney Rushing, ServisFirst Bank Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. “We're grateful for everyone who joined us to share ideas and collaborate. Together, we had impactful conversations about strengthening SBA lending programs, improving access to capital and creating more opportunities for the entrepreneurs and small businesses that drive our communities forward.” For more information regarding ServisFirst Bank’s announcement, please contact Krista Conlin at Krista@KCProjects.net. For more about ServisFirst Bank, please visit www.servisfirstbank.com . ABOUT SERVISFIRST BANK ServisFirst Bank is a full-service commercial bank focused on commercial banking, correspondent banking, treasury management, private banking and the professional consumer market, emphasizing competitive products, state-of-the-art technology and a focus on quality service. Recently, the Bank announced that its assets exceed $18 billion. The Bank offers sophisticated treasury management products, Internet banking, home mortgage lending, remote deposit express banking, and highly competitive rates. ServisFirst Bank was formed in May 2005, and has offices in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, NorthCarolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. In April 2015, and annually thereafter,ServisFirst Bank has earned investment- grade ratings and a stable outlook from Kroll BondRating Agency (KBRA), which measures companies’ financial fundamentals. ServisFirstBancshares, Inc. files periodic reports with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission(SEC). Copies of its filings may be obtained at www.servisfirstbancshares.com . ABOUT THE U.S. SMALL BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION (SBA) The U.S. Small Business Administration helps power the American dream of entrepreneurship. As the leading voice for small businesses within the federal government, the SBA empowers job creators with the resources and support they need to start, grow, and expand their businesses or recover from a declared disaster. It delivers services through an extensive network of SBA field offices and partnerships with public and private organizations. To learn more, visit www.sba.gov . ###

body_text: View All News Vontier Debuts on Newsweek’s World’s Greenest Companies List July 7, 2026 Download (opens in new window) RALEIGH, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced that it was named one of Newsweek’s World’s Greenest Companies for 2026 . This is the first year the company was included on the selective list, following earlier recognition on Newsweek’s lists of America’s Greenest and Most Responsible Companies. Inclusion on the global list represents a higher level of international distinction, requiring Vontier’s operations to meet 25 rigorous EU sustainability criteria. “At Vontier, we see sustainability as smart business – driving efficiency, accountability and long-term value,” said Katie Rowen, EVP and Chief Transformation and Operations Officer at Vontier. “Throughout the year, we’ve mobilized hundreds of colleagues across the globe to identify and implement practical efficiency gains, creating a ripple effect of transformative change. We’re proud of the progress we’ve made thus far and are committed to continuing to raise the bar.” The annual ranking, produced in partnership with Plant-A Insights Group and GIST Impact, honors the top 850 companies across 28 countries for demonstrated performance in environmental sustainability. Newsweek evaluated over 8,000 companies across four categories: greenhouse gas emissions, water usage, waste generation and sustainability data disclosure and commitments. The Newsweek recognition builds on Vontier’s growing portfolio of sustainability achievements, including those from CDP, EcoVadis, USA TODAY, American Business Awards, International Sustainability Awards and TIME. For more information on the company’s nationally recognized sustainability efforts, please visit www.vontier.com/responsibility . About Vontier Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves — delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Vontier has a culture of continuous improvement and innovation worldwide. Additional information about Vontier is available on the Company’s website at www.vontier.com .
